The All-New 2027 Entegra Coach Emblem 36U Class A Luxury RV for sale Features Customer Value Package Washer/Dryer Combination Shadow Paint Front Overhead Loft More About This Class A The Emblem is Entegra Coach's top-tier gas Class A, built on the Ford F53 chassis with the 7.3L V8 making 335HP and 468 ft.-lb torque and the E-Z Drive Elite handling package for a stable, controlled ride. Standard full-body paint, pass-through basement storage and residential-style appliances give it presence and livability beyond most gas coaches. Inside, solid surface counters throughout, vinyl plank flooring, hardwood cabinet doors, and an electric fireplace deliver a finished and residential feel. New features for 2027 includes paint options, dovetail drawer boxes, LED headlights, fabric sofa/theater option and dune gray painted cabinets or coastal decor wood.
